title: introduce-adaptive-cohort-sampler-and-interactive-trace-annotations
author: Maya Linton
commits: feat(sampler): add adaptive cohorting algorithm and configuration
perf(sampler): stream-aware boundary preservation for chunked streams
ui(console): add interactive trace annotation layer and cohort matrix panel
docs: add observability guide for cohort sampling and fidelity toggles
test(e2e): integrate cohorted-sampler into replaybench scenarios
description:
Motivation: Long-tail cost and latency issues often cluster by high-level customer behavior but are masked by uniform sampling. This PR introduces an adaptive cohort sampling service and an interactive trace annotation layer in the Observability Console to enable fast triage of per-tenant token-cost/latency cohorts.

Summary: Adds a streaming-aware cohort sampler that preserves chunk boundaries, assigns lightweight cohort labels to invocations, and exports cohorted sampled traces and aggregated micro-metrics. The console gains a Cohort Overlap Matrix panel and an interactive Trace Annotation Layer that surfaces cohort membership, sample fidelity, and heuristic attributions (kernel contention, prefetch misses, cold KV cache). Detailed docs and replaybench integration are included.

Primary changes: 1) sampler service: new adaptive_cohorting pipeline with config knobs (target_fidelity, min_cohort_size, recency_weight) and stream boundary handler to avoid splitting chunked streaming responses; 2) telemetry: cohort labels are emitted as span attributes and as metric labels (cohort.id, cohort.fidelity_score); 3) console UI: Cohort Overlap Matrix (heatmap of tenant vs. cohort density), Trace Annotation Layer (token-level badges with cost delta and heuristic flags), and a per-panel fidelity toggle to switch between raw and cohorted views; 4) e2e: replaybench scenarios updated to validate sampler fidelity and backfill behavior; 5) docs and runbook: new observability guide and oncall playbook section covering cohort investigation and sample-calibration steps.

Why this is different: Existing sampling focused on priority or cost-weighted selection; this approach groups similar invocations into cohorts using a lightweight clustering (shape of prompt, average token velocity, model variant) and adapts sampling rate per-cohort based on observed variance and cost impact. The stream-aware boundary preservation prevents noisy artifacts where streaming chunks are sampled separately and misattribute cost spikes.

Files of note: cohort_sampler.rs contains the adaptive scoring loop and boundary-preservation state machine; telemetry_instrumentation.rs adds cohort label enrichment for OpenTelemetry spans and Prometheus counters; CohortOverlapMatrixPanel.tsx includes an emphemeral fast-path renderer for large cardinality cohorts to avoid blocking the console thread.

Testing and CI: Unit tests added for coordinator edge cases (cohort shrink/grow), property tests for boundary preservation, and an integration test that runs replaybench against a synthetic tenant mix. CI pipeline shows all checks passing (unit, integration, lint, console-build).

Rollout plan: Feature-flagged behind obs.coho_sampler.enabled. Phased rollout: enable for 5% of tenants (canary) for 48h, compare sampled vs. full-scan fidelity in replaybench, then 25% for 72h, then global. Live telemetry dashboard included in the PR with acceptance criteria: cohort fidelity >85% for high-impact tenants and no increase in alert noise.

Docs & runbook: docs/observability/cohort-sampler.md describes sampling model, configuration examples, fidelity calibration steps, and a small oncall playbook to follow when a cohort shows a cost spike (investigate kernel queueing, check prefetch warmup meters, inspect kv cache miss tags).

Backwards compatibility & performance: Cohort labels are optional OTel attributes; existing pipelines ignore them if unset. Sampler adds a lightweight fingerprint (sha1-like) and keeps CPU overhead under 2% in perf testing. We added a validation mode to run sampler in "shadow" to validate before enabling label emission.

Checklist:
- [x] implement adaptive cohort sampler and streaming boundary preservation
- [x] add cohort label emission for traces and metrics
- [x] console panels and annotation layer
- [x] unit & integration tests
- [x] docs and runbook
- [x] feature flag and phased rollout plan

Related work: ENG-1985 (sampling improvements), ENG-2021 (console trace UX), SUP-4123 (customer report of misattributed streaming cost).

Merge notes: Squash-merged after reviewers sign-off and CI green. Post-merge: scheduled a canary rollout and a follow-up PR to add cohort persistence TTL tuning.
review_comments: Arjun Patel: Left a few nits in cohort_sampler.rs; please add a brief comment explaining recency_weight semantics and a unit test for recency-weighted eviction.
Evan Chen: Can we make the cohort id stable across restarts for short TTLs? Suggested adding a namespace+time-windowed hash; author implemented a lightweight stable fingerprint in config.rs.
Lena Morales: Console looks great; a11y note — ensure the heatmap has aria-labels for keyboard users. Updated styles/trace-annotations.css accordingly.
Maya Linton (author): Addressed Arjun's and Lena's comments, added unit test for recency behavior, and added aria attributes to heatmap renderer. Resolved comments.
release_notes: Introduce adaptive cohort sampling and interactive trace annotations: enables grouped sampling for better long-tail observability, adds Cohort Overlap Matrix panel and trace-level cohort badges, and includes rollout plan and docs.
